title: Photo Location Guard
summary: Reads a photo's EXIF and XMP before upload and offers one-tap location removal, so a picture doesn't reveal where and when it was taken.
description: Pre-upload photo check that reads EXIF and XMP (GPS with its precision, capture time, camera serial, owner name, a hidden uncropped preview) and offers "Remove location", which re-encodes the photo upright in the browser and re-checks the result.
catches: GPS coordinates, with how precise they are
Camera serial number and owner name
Embedded preview that can show the uncropped original
limits: Reads JPEG metadata; other formats show an unsupported notice
Re-encoding drops all metadata and slightly changes image quality
Can't remove location visible in the picture itself (street signs, landmarks)
a11y: File input has a visible label and buttons to choose or change
Findings are in a polite live region; the details list is labelled
Remove shows aria-busy while working; errors use role=alert
server: Strip metadata on the server too before publishing uploads; a client-side strip can be skipped.
